scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/dom/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit
scripts.pack:local: npm run build && rm -rf packed && mkdir packed && for p in core dom angular theme; do (cd packages/$p/dist && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../packed >/dev/null); done && ls packed
scripts.publish:next: npm run build && for p in core dom theme angular; do npm publish packages/$p/dist --access public --tag next || exit 1; done
scripts.publish:dry: npm run build && for p in core dom theme angular; do npm publish packages/$p/dist --access public --tag next --dry-run 2>&1 | grep -E 'name:|version:|total files:|package size:'; done
scripts.publish:latest: npm run build && for p in core dom theme angular; do npm publish packages/$p/dist --access public || exit 1; done
scripts.docs: npm run docs:api && vitepress dev site
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:api && vitepress build site
